definitions.stable: the production encoder with `--codec-set stable`: the four original codecs, ids 0-3
definitions.extended: the production encoder with `--codec-set extended`: those four plus the three promoted in v0.3, ids 4-6
definitions.verify: `vpng verify` decodes every tile and compares the result with the original pixels; a non-zero exit is a lossless failure
definitions.ratio: file bytes divided by canonical pixel bytes; below 1.0 is smaller
